name: Archimedes
bio: Archimedes is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no date for the poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 50).

poems.title: Book VII, 50: On the Same
poems.author: Archimedes
poems.text: Tread not, O poet, the path of Euripides, neither essay it, for it is hard for man to walk therein. Smooth it is to look on, and well beaten, but if one sets his foot on it it is rougher than if set with cruel stakes. Scratch but the surface of Medea,! Aeetes’ daughter, and thou shalt lie below forgotten. Hands off his crowns.
